_comment: Secondary-capture checkpoint, measured live 2026-11-13 ~13:30 (Ali). TCP = gripper frame in world mm; tool axis points from the TCP at the webcam lens.

webcam.how_measured: wrist RealSense depth from home with the base at -90 deg (joints [-90, 22.57, -50.68, 0, -74.05, 0])
webcam.note: rdk:builtin:webcam, /dev/video38, 640x480 YUYV, wide-angle with barrel distortion; no depth stream

checkpoint.image: claws centered at ~(330, 245); ~3.5 px/mm at the part; background = black claw bar, grey divider around it
checkpoint.reach: motion.move from a pointing-down hover over (262, -166, 300): 1.4 s; back 1.4 s

yaw-35.why: wrist RealSense would hit the laptop at x -8..326, y -600..-289 (move the laptop, or use yaw-20)

pitch+25.why: wrist RealSense would hit the table (it hangs below the claws in this roll)

jaw_axis: Fingers close along the GRIPPER Y axis (verified: close/open at the checkpoint, filmed by the webcam). At home (theta 0) that is world y. pipeline.JawFrame assumes x -> set grasp.jaw_offset_deg 90 -> 0.
